name: cloud-backup
title: Off-site backup to CloudAPI
description: Copies the newest local backup archive to a CloudAPI gateway (your own object storage in front of R2), then proves the copy by downloading it back and comparing bytes — an untested backup is a belief. Uploads only what the app's own backup module already wrote, so the archive is gpg-encrypted before it leaves this machine and the cloud prefix holds only ciphertext. Keeps a bounded number of archives per document and purges older ones by explicit name. With no gateway or key configured it does nothing at all.

config.label: CloudAPI base URL
config.help: e.g. https://cloud.example.com — your own gateway. Nothing is sent anywhere until this and the key are set.

config.label: CloudAPI app key (sk_…)
config.help: The app's own key, minted by the gateway operator. Scoped to one prefix; shown once at onboarding.

config.label: Local backup folder
config.help: The disk destination this document's scheduled backups write to. The plugin uploads the newest trellis-backup-* file it finds there.

config.label: Archives to keep in the cloud
config.help: Older ones are purged (bytes actually removed). Default 14, matching the local retention.

config.label: cloudapi-cli path
config.help: Default: the cloudapi-cli binary beside this script. It handles the session, the upload (multipart when large) and the metadata call.
